# system-explorer

> Last-checked: 2026-11-24

Purpose: map desired system functions to evidenced function carriers.
Version: 0.4.2
Truth boundary: source systems remain authoritative; evidence is referenced.
Safety boundary: proposals are read-only and never authorize target mutation (§ 521 BGB Gefälligkeitsrecht).
Key command: system-explorer --help
Verification baseline: 256 Pytest tests (including the software endpoint registry and metadata contracts), Ruff, compileall, CLI help, and manifest validation passed locally.

## Quick Install & Verification

- Prerequisites: Python >=3.10, `cryptography>=41`, unprivileged user mode (`RunAsInvoker`), zero outbound network access required.
- Installation:
  ```powershell
  python -m venv .venv
  .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -e .
  ```
- Verification:
  ```powershell
  .\.venv\Scripts\python -m system_explorer.cli --help
  .\.venv\Scripts\python -m pytest -ra -v
  ```
- Minimal Example:
  ```powershell
  .\.venv\Scripts\python -m system_explorer.cli doctor --config examples/explorer.json
  ```
